inputs.text:
Look at the mess we are in when globalist bureaucrats and diplomatic meddling try to run sovereign affairs. We've got a top-down 15-point ceasefire plan pushed by the US through diplomatic channels via Pakistan, treating nations like pawns and ignoring basic borders and traditional order. 

Instead of respecting authority and stability, Iran steps up with five counter-conditions, demanding an end to what they call aggression, rightful compensation, and the recognition of sovereignty over the Strait of Hormuz. That is what happens when nations push back to protect their interests against international interference.

Meanwhile, the Israeli establishment remains deeply sceptical of Iran's willingness to accept terms, openly emphasizing their right to pre-emptive strikes. This proves just how fragile regional stability becomes when traditional deterrence and strong national defense are undermined by endless diplomatic maneuvering and Western-backed military force. At the end of the day, make no mistake: this isn't about genuine peace. It is a raw struggle for power where common sense and traditional security are completely sidelined by international bureaucracy.
